posthoc.interpretation: The o4 image and exact o4 record remained attached/in memory at o5 and reached both Jev stages. The newly emitted matching/precondition hypothesis weakened to uncertain and was assigned a different condition ID. This trace supports input retention plus changed interpretation; it does not demonstrate transport loss. At o5 the native model and Jev categorical judgments both labelled e1 execute/e3 information, and raw argmax preferred e1 (0.79 vs0.17). o6 visibly returned to the original blocked page. Internal reasoning, causal responsibility among stages, and human fidelity cannot be inferred.
